def mvcc.api.evDummy : mvcc.EvM :=
  { del := false, kv := { key := [], createRev := W64 0, modRev := W64 0, version := W64 0, value := [], lease := W64 0 },
    prevKv := none }

def mvcc.api.fsCode (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Pos → DiscreteO (Option Bool) :=
  {
    car :=
      match Pos.Countable.decode p with
      | some (i, ev) => Option.map (fun f => f ev) fs[i]?
      | none => none }

theorem mvcc.api.fsCode_inj {fs fs' : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)} (h : mvcc.api.fsCode fs =
    mvcc.api.fsCode fs') : fs = fs'

def mvcc.api.savedFilters (γ : GName) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : IProp GF :=
  savedAnythingOwn γ DFrac.discard (mvcc.api.fsCode fs)

theorem mvcc.api.savedFilters_alloc (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : ⊢ |==> ∃ γ,
    mvcc.api.savedFilters γ fs

theorem mvcc.api.fsCode_at (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (i : Nat) (ev : mvcc.EvM) :
    (mvcc.api.fsCode fs (Pos.Countable.encode (i, ev))).car = Option.map (fun f => f ev) fs[i]?

theorem mvcc.api.savedFilters_agree (γ : GName) (fs fs' : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) :
    mvcc.api.savedFilters γ fs ∗ mvcc.api.savedFilters γ fs' ⊢ ⌜fs = fs'⌝

theorem mvcc.api.savedFilters_persistent (γ : GName) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) : Persistent
    (mvcc.api.savedFilters γ fs)
